settings.manageEmail: Connect the hotel mailbox to read, send and reply to email

help.gmail: Use a 16-character App Password, not your normal Gmail password. In your Google Account: Security → turn on 2-Step Verification → search "App passwords" → create one named "Hotel System" → paste it here. IMAP is always on for Gmail.
help.zoho: In Zoho Mail: Settings → Mail Accounts → IMAP Access → enable IMAP. If 2-factor login is on, create an Application-Specific Password under Zoho Accounts → Security and use it here.
help.custom: Find the IMAP and SMTP settings in your hosting panel (cPanel: Email Accounts → Connect Devices). Usually IMAP port 993 and SMTP port 465 with SSL on, and the username is the full email address.
